title: VisionWatchRequest
description: vision.watch-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/watch (owner-granted camera alerts). `classes` names 1–20 things to look for (snow, delivery, package, a DETR label, or "scene change"); `previous_image` is required for a scene change and is compared by histogram.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.
